name: Night latch
definition: a rim-mounted latch lock on the inside face of a door, with a latch bolt and a key cylinder or snib.

name: Rim lock
definition: a box lock fixed to the surface of the door, with a bolt that shoots into a staple or keep.

name: Euro cylinder
definition: a profile cylinder (the key-operated barrel) that fits a euro-profile mortice lock case.

name: Mortice deadlock
definition: a lock case sunk into the door edge whose bolt is thrown by key only and does not spring back.

name: Mortice sashlock
definition: a lock case sunk into the door edge with both a spring latch and a key-thrown deadbolt.

name: Deadbolt
definition: a stand-alone bolt lock (single or double cylinder, or thumb-turn) fitted through the door with a throw bolt.

name: Knob or lever lockset
definition: a handle set (knob or lever) that includes a lock, fitted through the door.

name: Multipoint lock
definition: a door lock that throws bolts or hooks into the frame at several points along the door edge.

name: Patio door lock
definition: a lock made for a sliding or French (patio) door.

name: Door bolt
definition: a sliding bolt fixed to a door to hold it shut.

name: Door chain
definition: a short chain that limits how far a door can open.

name: Window lock
definition: a lock or catch fixed to a window or sash to stop it opening, lockable window handles included.

name: Open-shackle padlock
definition: a padlock whose shackle is largely exposed above the body.

name: Closed-shackle padlock
definition: a padlock whose body shrouds most of the shackle to resist cutting.

name: Hasp and staple
definition: a hinged strap and eye fixed to a door and frame, through which a padlock is passed.

name: Security chain
definition: a heavy hardened chain made to secure gates, sheds or loose items with a padlock.

name: Cable lock
definition: a flexible steel cable with a lock, used to secure loose items.

name: Ground anchor
definition: a heavy anchor fixed in a floor or wall that an item is chained or locked to.

name: Safe [金庫]
definition: a steel strongbox with a lock, built to resist forced entry (and often fire), in any installation (freestanding, wall, floor, furniture) and any grade.

name: Fire-resistant safe, document box or chest
definition: a container rated against fire only, cabinet or portable lid-opening chest, made to protect papers and media from fire.

name: Key safe (outdoor key box) [キーボックス]
definition: a small lockable box, often wall-mounted outdoors, holding a door key.

name: Key cabinet
definition: a lockable cabinet fitted with hooks for many keys, sold among security goods.

name: Cash box
definition: a small portable lockable box for money.

name: Firearms cabinet or gun safe [Waffenschrank]
definition: a lockable steel cabinet or safe made to store guns.

name: Intruder alarm system
definition: a kit of control panel, sensors and sounder sold and compared as one burglar-alarm system (provisional until attested, K-1).

name: Motion sensor
definition: a detector that senses movement in a room and signals or sounds.

name: Door and window contact alarm
definition: a magnetic contact that sounds or signals when a door or window opens.

name: Personal attack alarm
definition: a hand-held device that makes a loud noise to deter an attacker.

name: Security camera
definition: a fixed camera made to watch and record a place for protection.

name: Pan-tilt security camera
definition: a security camera with a motor that turns and tilts it.

name: Floodlight camera
definition: a security camera built into a floodlight.

name: Video doorbell
definition: a doorbell with a camera that shows and records the caller.

name: Doorbell and chime
definition: a push button with a sounder that announces a caller, without a camera.

name: Door phone
definition: an entry panel with speaker (and screen) linked to an indoor unit for speaking to a caller.

name: Camera system kit
definition: a set of cameras and recorder sold and compared as one system (provisional until attested, K-1).

name: Letterbox
definition: a freestanding, wall or post mailbox for letters.

name: Parcel box
definition: a larger lockable box for receiving deliveries.

name: Anti-climb spike [忍び返し]
definition: spikes fixed on top of a wall or fence to deter climbing.

name: Security window film
definition: a clear film applied to glass to hold it together when struck.

name: Smoke alarm
definition: a ceiling alarm that senses smoke and sounds.

name: Heat alarm
definition: an alarm that senses a rise in temperature and sounds, for kitchens and garages.

name: CO alarm
definition: an alarm that senses carbon monoxide gas.

name: Combined smoke and CO alarm
definition: one alarm unit that senses both smoke and carbon monoxide.

name: Gas detector
definition: a detector for natural gas or LPG leaks.

name: Water extinguisher
definition: a portable extinguisher discharging water.

name: Water-mist extinguisher
definition: a portable extinguisher discharging a fine water mist.

name: Foam extinguisher
definition: a portable extinguisher discharging foam.

name: CO2 extinguisher
definition: a portable extinguisher discharging carbon dioxide gas.

name: Dry-powder extinguisher
definition: a portable extinguisher discharging dry powder.

name: Wet-chemical extinguisher
definition: a portable extinguisher discharging wet chemical, for cooking-oil fires.

name: Extinguisher spray
definition: a small aerosol-can fire-extinguishing spray.

name: Fire blanket
definition: a fabric sheet in a pouch that is pulled out to smother a small fire.

name: Hardware-mounted gate
definition: a gate screwed to the wall or frame, usable at the top of stairs.

name: Pressure-mounted gate
definition: a gate held in an opening by pressure alone, with no screws.

name: Retractable gate
definition: a gate whose panel retracts into a housing at the side of the opening.

name: Cabinet and drawer latch
definition: a latch or catch that keeps a cabinet door or drawer from being opened.

name: Toilet lock
definition: a catch that holds a toilet lid down.

name: Furniture anti-tip strap
definition: a strap or bracket that fixes furniture or a television to a wall.

name: Corner and edge guard
definition: a soft cushion fitted on furniture corners or edges.

name: Outlet cover
definition: a cover or plug that blocks the holes of a wall socket.

name: Stove knob cover
definition: a cover over the control knobs of a cooker.

name: Window guard
definition: a bar, grille or restrictor that stops a window opening wide enough for a fall.

name: Door stop
definition: a wedge, spring or holder that holds a door open or keeps it from slamming or being pushed.

name: Video room monitor (baby monitor)
definition: a camera and receiver or app for watching and hearing a baby or person in another room.

name: Snap trap
definition: a spring-loaded trap that kills a mouse or rat.

name: Insect trap
definition: a sticky, baited or light trap that catches insects.

name: Live-catch cage trap
definition: a cage trap that catches an animal alive.

name: Rodenticide bait
definition: poison bait for mice and rats.

name: Bait station
definition: a box or tray that holds bait so that only the pest can reach it.

name: Insect bait
definition: a gel or paste bait for ants, cockroaches or similar.

name: Aerosol insecticide
definition: an insecticide sold in a spray can.

name: Insecticide foam
definition: an insecticide that is applied as foam.

name: Insecticide powder
definition: an insecticide dust.

name: Fogger
definition: a can that releases insecticide as a fog to fill a room.

name: Mosquito coil
definition: a burning spiral that gives off insecticidal smoke.

name: Electric vaporiser
definition: a powered unit, plug-in or battery, that releases insecticide into room air from a liquid, mat or cartridge refill, by a heater or by a fan without heat; sold to kill or to repel.

name: Pest repeller (electronic)
definition: a powered device that drives pests away by ultrasound or similar signals alone, with no insecticide or chemical refill.

name: Moth repellent
definition: mothballs, cedar blocks or sachets that keep moths away.

name: Electric fly killer
definition: a lamp-and-grid or racket device that electrocutes insects.

name: Fly swatter
definition: a hand-held paddle for killing insects.

name: Bed mosquito net
definition: a net hung over a bed to keep insects off the sleeper.

name: Insect screen
definition: a mesh screen fitted to a window or door opening.

name: Bird spike
definition: spikes fitted on ledges to stop birds perching.

name: Bird netting for buildings
definition: netting and bird-proofing nets that keep birds out of buildings and structures.

name: Water-leak detector
definition: a sensor that detects water on the floor or in a pipe run and warns.

name: Network video recorder
definition: a recorder made to store the video of security cameras.

name: Coil holder
definition: a stand made to hold one mosquito coil.

name: Vaporiser refill
definition: a bottle, mat or cartridge of insecticide made to be used only in one maker's electric vaporiser units (one model or one range).
